gov-disclosure-check v1.1.0 — Adds in-depth compliance checking for government information disclosure processes.

- Introduces mandatory disclosure field validation (decision basis, responsible department, time limit, relief channel, data source)
- Provides a CLI tool with deterministic structured output and compliance determination (exit codes 0/1/2)
- Supports AI system/data compliance verification with zero dependencies
- Offers localized use cases and limitations, emphasizing the need for human/legal confirmation for key decisions
- Enhanced documentation, usage matrix, and compliance/disclaimer sections
